text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important decisions. One key choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one platform and often perform better, while cross-platform apps save time and money by working on both iOS and Android. Responsive design matters too, because users expect apps to look good on different screen sizes. After development, apps are usually published through app stores like Google Play or the App Store, where they must meet certain rules. Finally, performance is crucial: a fast, smooth app keeps users happy, while a slow app is quickly deleted.
